name: JOS - RedPill OBSW (STM32L496VGTx + FreeRTOS)
postCreateCommand: sudo -E bash -c 'apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates openssh-server gcc-arm-none-eabi libnewlib-arm-none-eabi && service ssh start && curl -fsSL https://tailscale.com/install.sh | sh && mkdir -p /var/lib/tailscale && setsid tailscaled --tun=userspace-networking --state=/var/lib/tailscale/tailscaled.state > /var/log/tailscaled.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & sleep 8 && tailscale up --authkey=$TS_AUTH --hostname=jos-codespace' && echo 'Toolchain ready: run make all in JOS/'
